job.sentence: Nothing structural is new here: every frame and every side of every split in play has been seen before. The job is lexical — 4 new lego(s): "I wouldn't like" → "je n'aimerais pas", "guess" → "deviner", "what's going to happen" → "ce qui va se passer", "tomorrow" → "demain".

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas
phrases.why: bare negated want-chain form, no infinitive yet, anchors initial/final position

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to learn
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas apprendre
phrases.why: adds infinitive to learn, a right neighbour not seen in the live basket

phrases.known_text: Today, I wouldn't like
phrases.target_text: Aujourd'hui, je n'aimerais pas
phrases.why: fronts a time adjunct so the LEGO closes the fragment, giving it final position and a left neighbour

phrases.known_text: After you finish, I wouldn't like to say something
phrases.target_text: Après que tu aies fini, je n'aimerais pas dire quelque chose
phrases.why: embeds the LEGO after a temporal clause, medial position with a new left neighbour

phrases.known_text: Now, I wouldn't like to speak with you
phrases.target_text: Maintenant, je n'aimerais pas parler avec toi
phrases.why: another fronted-adjunct medial reading, new left neighbour now/maintenant

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to try to learn a word today
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas essayer d'apprendre un mot aujourd'hui
phrases.why: chains two infinitives after the LEGO, new right neighbour to try

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to say something in French
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas dire quelque chose en français
phrases.why: new right neighbour to say, complete natural sentence

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to practise speaking French with someone else
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas m'entraîner à parler français avec quelqu'un d'autre
phrases.why: new right neighbour to practise speaking, longer tail

phrases.known_text: After you finish, I wouldn't like to try
phrases.target_text: Après que tu aies fini, je n'aimerais pas essayer
phrases.why: reuses the temporal-clause left neighbour with a different right neighbour, distinct junction

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to explain what I mean
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas expliquer ce que je veux dire
phrases.why: new right neighbour to explain paired with a fixed complement

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to remember a word
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas me souvenir d'un mot
phrases.why: new right neighbour to remember, not used elsewhere in the basket

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to try as hard as I can today
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas essayer aussi fort que je peux aujourd'hui
phrases.why: as...as tail gives a longer, natural closing use phrase

phrases.known_text: to guess what I mean
phrases.target_text: deviner ce que je veux dire
phrases.why: bare infinitive fragment, initial position, right neighbour what

phrases.known_text: I want to guess
phrases.target_text: je veux deviner
phrases.why: new matrix I want instead of I'd like, final position

phrases.known_text: I can guess
phrases.target_text: je peux deviner
phrases.why: modal matrix, new left neighbour can

phrases.known_text: I'm going to guess
phrases.target_text: je vais deviner
phrases.why: going-to matrix directly on guess, new left neighbour going to

phrases.known_text: I'd like to try to guess now
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais essayer de deviner maintenant
phrases.why: adds a trailing adjunct after the LEGO instead of ending the sentence

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to guess what I mean
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas deviner ce que je veux dire
phrases.why: uses this seed's earlier LEGO as the matrix, right neighbour what

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure if I can guess today
phrases.target_text: je ne suis pas sûr de pouvoir deviner aujourd'hui
phrases.why: matrix know/sure frame, new left neighbour pouvoir

phrases.known_text: I can try to guess with someone else
phrases.target_text: je peux essayer de deviner avec quelqu'un d'autre
phrases.why: new right neighbour with, not end of sentence

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to try to guess the whole sentence
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas essayer de deviner toute la phrase
phrases.why: new right neighbour the whole

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess as hard as I can
phrases.target_text: je vais essayer de deviner aussi fort que je peux
phrases.why: new right neighbour as hard, going-to matrix with a full tail

phrases.known_text: I'd like to guess after you finish
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais deviner après que tu aies fini
phrases.why: temporal clause follows the LEGO directly, new right neighbour after

phrases.known_text: I want to try to guess in French
phrases.target_text: je veux essayer de deviner en français
phrases.why: new right neighbour in French on the I want matrix

phrases.known_text: What's going to happen
phrases.target_text: Ce qui va se passer
phrases.why: bare LEGO as a standalone question, initial position anchor

phrases.known_text: to guess what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: deviner ce qui va se passer
phrases.why: extends with matrix verb guess, left neighbour introduced

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais expliquer ce qui va se passer
phrases.why: new matrix verb explain

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: je ne suis pas sûr de ce qui va se passer
phrases.why: matrix know/sure frame, left neighbour de

phrases.known_text: what's going to happen now
phrases.target_text: ce qui va se passer maintenant
phrases.why: trailing adjunct so the LEGO is no longer sentence-final

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to guess what's going to happen now
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas deviner ce qui va se passer maintenant
phrases.why: combines the guess-matrix with the trailing adjunct, new junction

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure what's going to happen today
phrases.target_text: je ne suis pas sûr de ce qui va se passer aujourd'hui
phrases.why: new trailing adjunct today on the sure-matrix

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what's going to happen with you
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais expliquer ce qui va se passer avec toi
phrases.why: new trailing adjunct with you on the explain-matrix

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess what's going to happen with someone else
phrases.target_text: je vais essayer de deviner ce qui va se passer avec quelqu'un d'autre
phrases.why: going-to matrix with the guess-chain and a trailing adjunct, new left/right combination

phrases.known_text: I can guess what's going to happen today
phrases.target_text: je peux deviner ce qui va se passer aujourd'hui
phrases.why: modal matrix reusing the today adjunct on the guess-left, distinct junction

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what's going to happen now
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais expliquer ce qui va se passer maintenant
phrases.why: explain-matrix with now instead of with you, distinct junction

phrases.known_text: I'm trying to guess what's going to happen as hard as I can
phrases.target_text: j'essaie de deviner ce qui va se passer aussi fort que je peux
phrases.why: progressive matrix with an as...as tail, new right neighbour

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to explain what's going to happen today
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas expliquer ce qui va se passer aujourd'hui
phrases.why: combines wouldn't-like with the explain-matrix and today, distinct junction

phrases.known_text: to speak French tomorrow
phrases.target_text: parler français demain
phrases.why: final position, LEGO closes the fragment

phrases.known_text: Tomorrow, I'd like to speak French
phrases.target_text: Demain, j'aimerais parler français
phrases.why: fronted adjunct, clean initial position

phrases.known_text: to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: deviner ce qui va se passer demain
phrases.why: final position, combines with an earlier LEGO of this seed

phrases.known_text: I'd like to speak French tomorrow with you
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais parler français demain avec toi
phrases.why: medial position, new right neighbour with

phrases.known_text: I wouldn't like to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: je n'aimerais pas deviner ce qui va se passer demain
phrases.why: final position, chains all four of this seed's LEGOs

phrases.known_text: Tomorrow, I wouldn't like to guess
phrases.target_text: Demain, je n'aimerais pas deviner
phrases.why: initial position, new right neighbour je

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what's going to happen tomorrow with you
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais expliquer ce qui va se passer demain avec toi
phrases.why: medial position, new left neighbour passer paired with with

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess tomorrow
phrases.target_text: je vais essayer de deviner demain
phrases.why: final position, new left neighbour guess

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: je ne suis pas sûr de ce qui va se passer demain
phrases.why: final position, matrix know/sure frame

phrases.known_text: I can try to guess tomorrow with you
phrases.target_text: je peux essayer de deviner demain avec toi
phrases.why: medial position, modal matrix with a trailing adjunct

phrases.known_text: I'd like to remember the whole sentence tomorrow
phrases.target_text: j'aimerais me souvenir de toute la phrase demain
phrases.why: final position, new left neighbour phrase

phrases.known_text: Tomorrow, I'm trying to guess what's going to happen
phrases.target_text: Demain, j'essaie de deviner ce qui va se passer
phrases.why: initial position, new right neighbour j'essaie
